headline: South Korea Exports Extend Growth Driven by AI Semiconductor Boom
summary: South Korea's exports maintained robust growth propelled by an AI-fuelled chip boom. The shipment surge puts the country on track to surpass $1 trillion in annual exports for the first time in 2026.
why: South Korea is home to major global memory chip makers, making its monthly trade performance a key indicator of global technology demand and capital spending cycles.

impacts.name: South Korea
impacts.why: Strong demand for artificial intelligence memory chips is driving export growth toward historical highs.
